sources.label: Unlock your digital freedom. Free yourself from Big tech Corporations
sources.author: Proteus
patch_list: Block Motion Sensors
Attempts to disable Chromium's Android sensor provider; may also block ambient sensors. Requires device validation.
Block Popups & Ratings
Disables the identified rating and Brave Ads signup eligibility checks; other dialogs can still appear.
Block Telemetry
Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.
Brave Origin
Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, and VPN.
Clean New Tab
Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.
Close Tab In Group Order
Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.
Custom Brave theme
Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.
Preserve last active tab
Disables the identified new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity. Does not prevent tab unloading under memory pressure.
Remove Extra Languages
Replaces larger unselected Chromium locale PAKs with the English fallback; gender variants and Android resources are not removed.
Remove Unused AI & VPN
Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.
Skip Welcome Screens
Reports the first-run flow complete; may skip essential consent, search or setup screens.
Stop Background Wakeups
Disables the identified Chromium background-sync scheduler gate; other wakeups remain and site background sync can break.
Stop Promo Notifications
Disables identified Chromium tips and retention notification entry points; other notifications may remain.
Stop Text Sharing with System
Disables Chromium's OnscreenContentProvider content-capture gate, not every possible text-sharing mechanism.

patch_list: Brave auto-hide toolbar with accessibility services
Lets the address bar auto-hide while an accessibility service is on.
Brave custom webpage fonts
Renders webpages in your chosen font. Icons and emoji keep theirs. Restart the browser after changing.
Brave font picker in settings
Adds Settings > Appearance > Custom font. Use a font APK or a TTF, OTF or TTC file.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Brave Browser Android (v1.100.58) featuring native Media & HL
sources.author: Brave
patch_list: Allow Incognito Screenshots
Enables taking screenshots and viewing recents thumbnails inside Incognito mode.
AMOLED Black Theme
Forces pure AMOLED black (#000000) backgrounds for dark mode surfaces, menus, omnibox, and settings.
Block Motion Sensors
Disables Chromium's Android PlatformSensorProvider so web pages cannot read motion or orientation sensors.
Block Popups & Ratings
Disables Brave's rating prompt and Brave Ads signup onboarding dialog eligibility checks.
Brave Core Infrastructure
Provides unified active tab tracking and navigation lifecycle events for Brave patches.
Brave Origin
Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, Leo AI, and VPN.
Clean New Tab Page
Enforces 4-column tile grid, removes sponsored NTP background ads, and disables Brave News feed.
Clone Package & Branding
Modifies application package name, authorities, and permissions to allow side-by-side installation with official Brave.
Close Tab In Group Order
Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab instead of jumping forward.
Force Copy / Paste
Unblocks text selection, copy, cut, paste, and context menus on web pages where sites restrict them.
Force Max Refresh Rate
Forces display mode to maximum available refresh rate (90Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz) matching physical panel resolution.
Force Picture-in-Picture
Automatically removes disablePictureInPicture restrictions on all HTML5 videos so PiP is always allowed.
Media & HLS Downloader
Adds a native toolbar button, HLS stream sniffer, and background MP4 remuxer to Brave Browser.
Preserve Last Active Tab
Disables Brave's new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity so your last active tab stays open.
Remove Unused AR & XR
Deletes unused ARCore native libraries from the APK to reduce install size.
Skip Welcome Screens
Reports the first-run onboarding flow as complete to bypass welcome screens on fresh installs.
Startup Optimization
Bypasses partner customizations during cold start and drains deferred startup listeners immediately.
Stop Background Wakeups
Disables Chromium's background-sync task scheduler gate and cancels previously scheduled background-sync jobs.
Stop Promo Notifications
Disables Brave retention notification alarms/receivers and Chromium tips notification opt-in promos.
Strip Menu & Settings Bloat
Removes Brave Wallet, Leo AI, Brave News, Brave Rewards, and VPN from the app menu and settings.
Strip Tracking Parameters
Removes marketing, analytics, and advertising tracking parameters from copied and shared URLs.
Telemetry & Locale Trim
Disables P3A telemetry serialization, metrics reporting consent, and prunes unused locale resources.
